name: PT PP Presisi Tbk
summary: PT PP Presisi Tbk operates as an integrated heavy equipment-based construction company in Indonesia. It engages in civil work projects, including toll road projects, dams, airports, ports, and other projects; civil works comprising earthworks, cut and fill, soil structure improvement, road pavement, concrete, and rigid/flexible pavement; production plant business activities, such as production of ready-mixed concrete and aggregate; mining services; structural work, which consists of construction/foundation buildings such as excavation of soil and hardening the soil structures, and formwork services; and equipment rental, which include tower cranes, passenger hoists, crawler cranes, generator…
